scope: Exact Hebrew and version research reports and records: source fidelity, preservation boundaries, image identity, published-apparatus units and evidentiary limits. Not a source-selection or application judgment.

actual_source_inspection.source: Aleppo Codex, Miqraot Gedolot Haketer publisher mosaic
actual_source_inspection.inspection: Viewed full-image layout and both supplied native crops. Read body and margin in surrounding 13:36–39 context. Independently read publisher chapter text at verse 37 and reader HTML sefernum=8, prnum=13 with the image URL construction. Read publisher preprocessing and attribution notice.
actual_source_inspection.finding: Body final resh, with het and vav-like penult, fits עמיחור; margin fits עמיהוד with qere indication. Nearby David dalets and Geshur resh provide local controls. This is consistent with the edition's distinct written/read forms, not a new folio-side identification.
actual_source_inspection.limits: Report-aware qualitative inspection, not blinded or calibrated; publisher processing already occurred. Original Ben-Zvi photograph not inspected; no full pointing certification or Leningrad penult conclusion. Wrong 9_13 acquisition remains excluded. Photo reuse rights not granted.

actual_source_inspection.source: Pinned Qumran Digital Reader biblical JSON
actual_source_inspection.inspection: Ran exact-reference extraction with full line context and read 4Q51 fragment f102ii+103_106i+107_109a_b lines 37, 38 and 39.
actual_source_inspection.finding: The only returned manuscript is 4Q51. Line 38 brackets enclose the entire patronymic; its supplied spelling has het, not the he of the traditional qere. A verse hit is not surviving patronymic ink.
actual_source_inspection.limits: Pinned digital transcription only; no new DJD apparatus or scroll photograph consultation, no exhaustive DSS census, and no public full-corpus reproduction.

actual_source_inspection.source: WLC and UXLC 2.5 local XML; UXLC published change history
actual_source_inspection.inspection: Read exact WLC 2Sam.13.37 XML, pinned ZIP Books/Samuel_2.xml c13/v37, and publisher entry 2022.08.30–23 at word 7, folio175B column3 line19. Also read the publisher's Dotan foreword excerpts.
actual_source_inspection.finding: WLC written form ends in resh; UXLC ends in dalet and attaches t to the penultimate consonant. Qere is the same and remains a separate lane. The BHL Appendix A alternatives are correctly attributed to the publisher's report and retain question marks.
actual_source_inspection.limits: WLC and UXLC are not independent physical witnesses. No fresh BHL Appendix A, Breuer, BHS or BHQ consultation is certified; the earlier Leningrad image review is inherited, not repeated here.

actual_source_inspection.source: German Bible Society RH2006 and WG2007 selected texts
actual_source_inspection.inspection: Directly opened and read verse 37 and edition-identifying footers on both publisher pages.
actual_source_inspection.finding: Greek Εμιουδ and Latin Amiur differ in their endings. Both selected texts explicitly identify David; the Greek has the separate geographical expansion.
actual_source_inspection.limits: Selected edition texts, not full modern apparatuses or underlying manuscripts. No unique Hebrew retroversion or whole-version unanimity follows.

actual_source_inspection.inspection: Direct web chapter retrieval failed; an ordinary Chrome tab succeeded. Independently read displayed row13:37, neighboring variant-marked rows, file metadata, and personal-name lexical classification through browser accessibility text. No AI link was used.
actual_source_inspection.finding: The displayed patronymic is ܥܡܝܗܘܕ; David is explicit in the sitting/remaining-in-mourning construction, followed by many days. Metadata identifies a Leiden-derived text with some corrections from 7a1. The generic metadata chapter2/verse2 header is not the locus identifier.
actual_source_inspection.limits: No raw page archive, full Leiden apparatus, manuscript inspection or unanimity inference from the absence of a displayed row variant marker.

actual_source_inspection.source: Brooke, McLean and Thackeray 1927 Samuel apparatus and 1906 general conventions
actual_source_inspection.inspection: Visually read actual page renders and native apparatus detail, not OCR alone. Samuel-specific authority mappings were checked against its preface; general conventions were separately visually read.
actual_source_inspection.finding: Name unit, including p, b n o c2 e2 and Ethiopic s, is faithfully distinguished from the mourning units crossing the page break. Old Latin Amiot is not Vulgate Amiur. Upright b is an aggregate, Ethiopic s is restricted, and Coptic/Old Latin entries are edition reports. The B base and apparatus-silence cautions are supported. Initial working omission of n and uncertain Old Latin final letter were resolved before the final artifacts bound here.
actual_source_inspection.limits: Context-informed published-apparatus audit, not a blinded experiment, human specialist certification, or fresh reading of the underlying Greek/Coptic/Ethiopic/Old Latin manuscripts. Samuel-specific conventions control over the earlier volume.

actual_integrity_checks.canonical_source_main_english_note_ancho: Unchanged; existing note a after Ammihur concerns the implicit mourner, not name variation. Its future repair remains separately scoped.

review_limits: The Aleppo single-verse endpoint timed out during this review; the same publisher's chapter reader verse37, identity HTML, actual private image and native crops were successfully inspected.

Historical HTTP-response hashes without a saved raw response were not reproduced as if they were immutable source snapshots; their factual claims were checked on the accessible current publisher pages.
Sassoon access failure and lack of a locus reading remain limitations, not absence or survival evidence.
This review assesses the four bound research artifacts, not central reporting files, all repository tests or export products.
